:::{#def-input}
#### Input

The **input** $\Predvar$ of a data point (also called its **predictor** or **covariate**) is the observed random variable from which a [prediction](#def-prediction) of its [outcome](#def-outcome) is computed.

:::

{{< slidebreak >}}

:::{#exm-input}
#### The input in the best-predictor exercise

In @exr-best-predictor, the input $\Predvar$ takes the values $0$ and $1$, each with probability $0.5$.

:::
